dashboard.label: TA-backup Overview
dashboard.description: Collects backup-system health: last snapshot age and count for restic and borg repositories (from a config file), and active backup-related systemd timers

search.query: index=main sourcetype="backup:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="backup.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="backup:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
